info.title: Suppli Shipments API
info.description: Shipment tracking microservice: shipments, containers, cargo items (tags), status flow with history, date changes with audit trail, lookup, reports and Excel import. Authenticate with a bearer token from `POST /auth/login` (users) or an API-client token (integrations such as Suppli). Super admins select the company with the `X-Company-Id` header.
